QuestInfo.name: Making the Unbreakable Porcelain
QuestInfo.0: Ask the #b#t4032497##k, whom you rescued from the Red-Nose Pirates, to make you 2 #t4032477# pieces.
QuestInfo.1: The #t4032497# says that he will need some materials to make the #t4032477#, and told you what they are. Talk to #p2092100# to travel to #b#m925110010##k to find them.

0.0: Thank you so much for rescuing me! Let me know if there is anything I can do for you...\r\n#L0#I could really use some #b#t4032477#!#l\n#k
0.1: #t4032477#? Pfft, that's easy. Assuming I have all the materials. Which I don't. So it's hard.\r\n#L0##bOh, I can handle that. How can we get them?#l\n#k
0.2: Well, not 'we' so much as 'you' honestly... I'm not equipped for hunting...\r\n#L0##bI know, it's fine! I get this all the time. Just tell me where to get the stuff.#l\n#k
0.3: I sure do appreciate your honesty! Okay, there are some old pots and jars in the backyard. Old projects that didn't go so well. Break them to get #b100#k #b#t4000291##k and #b#t4000292##k pieces. That'll be enough to make your #t4032477#. #b#eIf you're ready, I'll go ahead and send you to the backyard#k#n.

no.0: Guess it's too much of a pain, huh? Well gee, I don't know how to thank you now...

1.0: Ooh, that looks like everything! Hand it over and I'll get right to work.

yes.0: Here it is, #t4032477#s. I honestly don't know what it would take to break this. I mean, maybe someone really high level... Really, REALLY high level...

item.0: Where are the items I asked for? It's #b#t4000291##k and #b#t4000292##k. And don't wander off! One wrong step and you could be... Ugh, I don't even want to think about it.\r\n#bJust talk to me. I'll send you where you need to go#n.#k
